subject: mathematics
concept: Performing translations, reflections, and rotations of figures on a coordinate plane
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student physically slides, flips, and rotates a shape tile on a coordinate grid
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a transformation description to the correctly transformed figure
exercise.abstract: Student finds the new coordinates of a figure after a described translation, reflection, or rotation

misconception_flags: reflects across the wrong axis or rotates in the wrong direction

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
